codeReview.summary: The implementation fully covers all requirements in the feature description and expectedBehavior. All hub primitives are correctly positioned: workspace dock at left edge, quick chat at bottom center, timer at bottom right, ReactFlow controls moved to top-right to avoid hub conflicts. Timer toggles and top breadcrumb are removed. Hub items are viewport-constrained via clampOffset. Tint zones use soft radial gradients. The new regression test verifies focus timer placement in the bottom-right zone contract.

summary: Feature w1-c3-hub-primitives passes review. All required hub primitives are implemented: workspace selector dock at left edge, unified quick chat/create launcher at bottom center, focus timer at bottom right, hub collapse toggle, timer toggles removed, top breadcrumb removed, viewport-constrained hub items via clampOffset, soft gradient-edged tint zones, and ReactFlow controls repositioned to top-right.
